title: Blackbird Race
notes: Official page read 2026-11-01: Hutchinson's racing tire with Mach Tread Ultimate compound, Ultraswift 3x127 TPI casing and polyamide reinforcement; tubeless ready and hookless. 700x28 240 g, 700x30 255 g, 700x32 300 g, 700x34 314 g (±7%), black; every size marked Made in France. Claims a 10% watt-efficiency gain over its predecessor.
